decisions.answer: Stay open, show the save and the refusal, keep Undo, retry only the choice.

decisions.topic: Ticked Clear all under a newer layout
decisions.answer: Clear this browser only and leave synced settings for the newer version.
Cleared on this browser. Synced settings were left for the newer version of Perchling that saved them. Update Perchling here to clear them too.

decisions.topic: Native account removal and synced Setup tombstones
decisions.answer: Build both in 2.0 now.

Any browser expires a tombstone 30 days after its edit time, during an automatic receive pass with sync on, dropping its local copy and removing the synced copy in a separate cleanup turn. Filter tombstones go with their Setup's. ARC-MOD-21 gains an exception.
Replace 1.x now: the first cutover change deletes the 1.x React app and src/lib, and main ships nothing until 2.0 is usable. Activation of a release stays held.
Never ship 1.5.0. 2.0 replaces 1.4.5 directly; the interim build matters only as an upgrade source path.
Narrow to https://www.youtube.com/* on both browsers, accepting that some upgraders may need to grant access again. Amend the spec.
Change the spec to describe the per-operation owners as built, not a single Store.change() with one Change union.
Pending: research what Vite+ (Vite, Rolldown, Oxc, Vitest, task runner) can give developer tooling, speed and bundle size before deciding the test runner.
Put them in Settings > Privacy & data. The agent writes the copy with pstack unslop; no separate review round.
Pick the shortcut's playlist
Use Material Symbols, not YouTube Music's own icon paths.
Count only 2.0 code; behavior the interim build delivers stays open until 2.0 code does it.

decisions.topic: Store reviewer credentials in CI (REL-STORE-21, 24, REL-CI-46)
decisions.answer: Design it now: the agent writes the design and credential-free tests, then brings them to the owner for approval before anything runs.
Stays off until ticket 25's live checks verify production ownership and session contracts on a real signed-in account.
Every piece of user-facing copy goes through pstack unslop.
